output.subject: A 38ms diff viewer for terminal-first engineers
output.pitch: Console.dev readers know that most 'fancy' diff tools slow down on large changes. termdiff renders a 10,000-line diff in 38ms — an order of magnitude faster than existing pagers. It delivers true side-by-side, word-level highlighting in the terminal via a zero-config static binary. Already at 4,200 GitHub stars and in Homebrew core, it’s built for engineers who review diffs daily in monorepos. Your audience uses git log -p and core.pager today — this drops right in. {APP_URL}
